verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms an install path exists: a community note describes a git-clone-and-copy install model, docs mention global vs vendored installs and project-local setup, and CONTRIBUTING describes a dev mode that symlinks skills into .claude/skills/. Nothing in the pack shows an actual quickstart guide or any claim about time to a working skill. missing for 10: a documented step-by-step quickstart, evidence of the under-five-minutes time-to-first-skill, hands-on or independent confirmation that a fresh install works quickly.
